scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.postinstall: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma || true
